preconditions.description: The number of lamps n must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n - 1 and all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: The list of main lamp indices must have length n - 1 and each index must be between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid_scheme else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to restore the original scheme, output -1.

postconditions.expression: valid_scheme and len(wires) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in wires)
postconditions.description: If a valid scheme is restored, output the index of the main lamp and n - 1 valid wire connections.
